components.name: The Bridge
components.description: Signature stage control: arch progress over four piers (done, active, blocked, waiting) above aligned stage tabs.
components.css: .ds-bridge { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e7dfd2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 20px 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Plus Jakarta Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-bridge svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-bridge-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 6px; margin-top: -4px; } .ds-tab { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-tab:hover { background: rgba(243,237,226,.6); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #bf092f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab b { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #4a4448; } .ds-tab small { font-size: 12px; color: #6f676a; } .ds-tab i { display: block; width: 0; height: 2px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; transition: width 300ms; } .ds-tab.is-sel { background: #f3ede2; } .ds-tab.is-sel b { color: #222023; } .ds-tab.is-sel i { width: 40px; background: #bf092f; } .ds-tab.is-blocked small { font-weight: 600; color: #a10727; }

components.name: Stage Dots

components.css: .ds-dots { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 9999px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-dot.done { background: #bf092f; } .ds-dot.blocked { background: #bf092f; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(191,9,47,.2); } .ds-dot.active { background: #fff; border: 2px solid #bf092f; } .ds-dot.waiting { background: #fff; border: 2px solid #d6cbb9; } .ds-link { width: 20px; height: 2px; background: #d6cbb9; } .ds-link.on { background: #bf092f; }

narrative.overview:
Shetu (সেতু) means bridge, and the product is built around one: a leave is a span with four piers (map, cover, during, return), and the interface shows where the leave stands on that span before it shows any table. Everything else is a calm, dense operations tool that stays out of the way: paper ground, white panels drawn with hairlines, ink type at product density, and a deep crimson rail anchoring navigation.

Colour is state, not decoration. Crimson means "act here" or "this is blocked"; leaf green means a rule passes; gold means something waits for a person's decision. Surfaces are flat and quiet so that those three signals carry. The system is light only and carries no emoji; icons are Lucide line icons at 16px.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground, white hairline panels, deep crimson rail.
Product density: 13px body, 11 to 15px UI, tabular figures everywhere.
Crimson, leaf and gold are state colours with fixed meanings.
The arch is a working control (the stage tabs), not an illustration.
Light theme only; no emoji; Lucide line icons.

rules.name: The Three Signals Rule
rules.body: Crimson is action or blocking, leaf is passing, gold is pending. Never use one of them for another meaning, and never add a fourth signal hue.

rules.name: The Readable Green Rule
rules.body: The deck's green (#2E9E5B) shipped as the darker leaf (#1f7a48) so small text on leaf-soft meets WCAG AA. Use leaf, not the deck green, for text and icons.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` is set on body; dates, counts and hours must align in columns. Do not switch it off.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Labels, table heads and badges are sentence case with normal tracking. There are no uppercase tracked labels and no eyebrow lines above headings.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Panels separate by a 1px line border on white, never by shadow.

dos: Do keep crimson for action and blocking, leaf for passing, gold for pending (The Three Signals Rule).
Do separate surfaces with a 1px hairline on white panels; keep panels shadowless.
Do set UI text at 13px with tabular figures; let weight (600 to 800) carry hierarchy.
Do use Lucide line icons at 16px (12px inside badges and markers), always paired with a text or aria label.
Do keep the bridge a working control with real states and keyboard tabs.
Do show the synthetic-data notice on every screen.
Do set Bangla in Hind Siliguri via the bangla font token.
donts: Don't use emoji anywhere in the interface.
Don't add a dark theme; the system is light only.
Don't put uppercase tracked eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't mark rows or cards with coloured side stripes; state lives in badges, markers, washes and the bridge.
Don't use the deck green (#2E9E5B) for text; use leaf.
Don't use rose for text or controls; it is the hangers' structural tint.
